item.note_add: VRF-6: a frame / stand quoted per Nos is 'MS frame / stand for ODU' (per Kg it stays 'MS Angle Base Frame Structure'). A cassette the BoQ sizes as 600 x 600 mm or 2' x 2' is a Cassette (its way FOUR-WAY COMPACT). A CSU / ceiling suspended unit is 'Ductable'. An ON/OFF central controller is the 'Touch Screen Central Controller'. A capacity written with a stray space ('6 .3 TR') is that number (6.3 TR). Cabling the BoQ ties to a drain pump (a plug top, a power point for the pump) is the pump's, not the unit's power cable.

remote_type.note: Remote controllers, AND every indoor unit whose price includes a remote: that remote's type, from the row, its notes or a heading / note that describes this unit. Wireless, handset or cordless = Cordless; corded, wired or 'with wire' on its own = Wired; when the text offers both ('corded or cordless', 'cordless/corded', 'corded less') = Cordless. 'None' when nothing says which.

way.note: Cassettes: the sheet's Type -- answered whenever the row, its notes or ANY heading or note above it states the way (one-way, two-way, four-way, compact). A 600 x 600 mm / 2' x 2' cassette is FOUR-WAY COMPACT.

includes_gas.note_add: A full / first / initial charge of refrigerant, or a price 'inclusive of refrigerant charge', means Yes.

includes_mccb.note_add: Breakers / protection (MCB, ELCB, MCCB, isolator) a note says the outdoor unit's price includes mean Yes.

includes_power.note_add: Cabling for a drain pump (a plug top, a power point for the pump) is NOT the unit's power cable.

notes_add: VRF-6 (owner, 2026-11-09): the remote's type follows the BoQ (ambiguous 'corded or cordless' -> Cordless, then the model's answer, then the words); every included extra that is not added says why; the own-row check reads each row's category first; '12HP x 2NOS' is a written split, a written module above the largest unit is split, a size no single unit matches takes the single that covers it unless a covering pair is cheaper (then the cheaper pair with the least excess); a cable length reaches only its own cable, 'AL' is aluminium, drain-pump cabling is not the power cable; accessories take the unit's make; per outdoor module: one MS frame / stand (its own Nos item), gas kg = HP, one MCB + ELCB by the HP schedule; built-in drain pump, scope conflicts and installation-only settled by the sheet's own rows; control wiring = comm cable; a 'quantified separately' note wins; two capacities refuse. second_opinion is OFF (owner 2026-11-09 18:52: the standing rule for every category, new-category testing included).
